Name: Sosthenes
Summary: Sosthenes was a ruler of the synagogue at Corinth who was beaten by the Greeks before Gallio's judgment seat after Gallio dismissed the Jews' case against Paul. He is traditionally identified with the Sosthenes who later greets the Corinthians with Paul, though Acts does not say so.
KeyStory: Sosthenes was beaten before the judgment seat while Gallio cared for none of these things.
LifeLesson: Gallio's indifference left Sosthenes bleeding at the tribunal. The world often shrugs at the church's wounds.
